# Commands that a docs page may have and a README does not need.
#
# One line per command, two fields separated by "|":
#   <Tab or *> | <command, with single spaces>
#
# "*" means every tab of every page. Lines that start with "#" and empty lines are ignored.
# Add a line only for an optional command (for example a tool that the reader may start).
# Do not add a line to hide a command that the reader must run.
